events.title: Demo Update — New World 2 Mid-Boss: Ashen Charger!
events.summary: Hello, this is the Revenant Survivors development team. This update brings a new mid-boss to World 2, “Ashen Battlefield”! ⚔️ New Mid-Boss — Ashen Charger The new mid-boss “Ashen Charger” now appears in World 2’s 15-minute survival map. It replaces the mid-boss that previously appeared in both World 1 and World 2. Head into Ashen Battlefield and take on this new mid-boss! We’ll keep improving the game to bring you more varied battles. Thank you! Mongma Studio
